entry.title: LiteVNA (NanoVNA Compatible)
entry.summary:
Vendor: DeepElec
Type: SDR
Price: 192.00

Introduction

If you're working with SDR, a Vector Network Analyser is a must-have tool to tune antennas, optimise performance and identify cable loss, SWR, and more.

For pentesters working in rapidly changing conditions, the LiteVNA-F will allow you to rapidly optimise your antenna to suit your target frequency and environment.

For example, when targeting remote controls on the 433MHz frequency, optimising a retractable antenna becomes rapid and intuitive; allowing for faster work and better performance.

The LiteVNA-F can be used via its touchscreen interface, or mobile and desktop applications for extended functionality and usability.

Covering 50kHz to 6.3GHz, the LiteVNA64 is an affordable, powerhouse multi-tool that will always earn its place in an SDR / IoT everyday carry pack.

There are many variations and grey-market clones of the LiteVNA on the market; many use cheaper components to lower the price, but at the cost of accuracy and precision.

Lab401's LiteVNA64 is the official, original version from Zeenko, with guaranteed latest hardware hardware revision.

Portable

Pocket-sized with internal battery & touch-screen and a shock resistant case.

Powerful

Use the touchscreen in the field. In the lab, the Desktop & mobile apps provide extra functionality and easy use.

Device Specifications

  • Frequency Range: 50kHz - 6.3GHz
  • Measuring Range:
    • 50kHz - 3GHz : >70dB
    • 3GHz - 6.3GHz : >50dB
  • Display: 3.95" 480*320 IPS Touchscreen  
  • Dimensions: 140 x 75 x 20mm
  • Connectivity: USB-C
  • Battery: 2000mAh
  • Case: Plastic

What's included

  • 1x Zeenko LiteVNA 64
  • 1x Calibration Kit
    • 1x 50 Ohm Load SMA Calibration Terminator
    • 1x Shorted SMA Calibration Terminator
    • 1x Open Ohm SMA Calibration Terminator
  • 1x Female-Female SMA through connector
  • 2x SMA Male-Male extension cables
  • 1x USB-A to USB-C Cable
  • 1x USB-C to USB-C Cable
